subject: Intercept only model works, Full model crashes

messages.author: a259015b36a46546
messages.subject: Intercept only model works, Full model crashes
parts:
Hello R-INLA Team,

I am running a multilevel logistic model on dataframe with 200,877 data point. When I run the intercept-only model (not multilevel) r-inla works (takes 1826.211 seconds) but the full model crashes with the verbose message below. The formula and models are also specified below. I also have a question about the highlighted part of the error message. Given the data has 200,877 data points why is the starting index more than the data points.


f1 <- nt_any_anem ~ 1  #intercept only works
model1<- inla(f1, data=women, family = "binomial", Ntrials = 1,
                control.family = list(link = "logit"),verbose=TRUE,
                 control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE))     ###intercept only works

 f2  <- nt_any_anem ~ factor(v013) + factor(rc_edu) + factor(rc_empl) + factor(rc_hins_any) + 
+   factor(rc_tobc_any) + factor(v190) + factor(ph_cook_clean) + log(mean_expo)  + f(ID, model = "iid") ##full model crashes

model2<- inla(f1, data=women, family = "binomial", Ntrials = 1,
                control.family = list(link = "logit"),verbose=TRUE,
                num.threads="2:1", control.inla=list(strategy="adaptive"),
                 control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE))
